idea-plugin.name: Prompt Templates
idea-plugin.description:
Create, manage and render reusable typed Markdown prompt templates inside JetBrains IDEs.

Templates remain ordinary Markdown files; typed variable metadata is stored separately.

  • Organise, search and edit a nested personal prompt library.
  • Invoke Quick Use by keyboard with ranked search, favourites and recents.
  • Resolve editor selection, current-file, project and clipboard context.
  • Attach explicitly selected file buffers and staged or unstaged Git diffs.
  • Preview exact rendered output before copying or inserting it.
  • Duplicate templates, capture selections and author typed variables with defaults.
  • Import, export, recover and diagnose templates, or open rendered Markdown in a scratch file.

The plugin makes no network requests, executes no prompts and sends no telemetry.

Compatible with standalone JetBrains IDEs based on IntelliJ Platform, with a minimum platform build of 262 (2026.2).

Automated Plugin Verifier coverage currently includes RustRover 2026.2 and WebStorm 2026.2.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Quick Use, reliable context and faster template authoring.

  • Find and invoke templates by keyboard with ranked search, favourites and recents.
  • Inspect frozen context and keep preview, input controls and output consistent across Quick Use and the tool window.
  • Recover interrupted saves, check revisions before overwriting and protect changed author drafts.
  • Duplicate templates, capture selections, configure defaults and field order, and insert or extract variables with Undo and Redo.
  • Use responsive forms with referenced inputs and correct multiline validation focus.
  • Attach explicit file buffers or Git diffs, export rendered Markdown to scratch files and browse optional worked examples.
